Now at the end of your trail, reap the mysterious reward of your work.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Travel to the deciphered location in [[Varajar Fells]].
* Defeat the [[Facet of Spirit]].
* Conquer the [[Facet of Destruction]].
* Vanquish the [[Facet of Existence]].
* Dominate the [[Facet of Death]].
* Thrash the [[Facet of Illusions]].
* Annihilate the [[Facet of Creation]].
* See [[Kerrsh]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 100 [[Asura Rank|Asura reputation points]]
* {{Skill icon|Air of Superiority}}
* [[Kerrsh's Staff]]

==Walkthrough==
In eastern [[Varajar Fells]] where [[Nifling the Chained]] usually is, [[Kerrsh]] will be waiting for you. Upon approaching, the crater will spawn the various facets faced in the preceeding quests one after the other. Defeat them all to complete the quest.

== Notes ==
* You can reach the spawning site faster from the [[Central Transfer Chamber]], if you have completed [[Destruction's Depths]].

* This quest is useful for [[farm]]ing Norn title points. 
** Under the [[Norn Hunting Party]] blessing, each Facet counts for 50 points. 
** Under the maximum hunt rank (after 250 kills), you can receive 1.8k (300/boss in normal mode) or 2.7k (450/boss in hard mode). 
** You can improve this further by waiting until you are under the effects of a [[Boss Bounty]]

* You may map to [[Tarnished Haven]] and collect the reward from Kerrsh there, as well.
* Kerrsh and the Facets will not spawn if [[A Good Deed]] and or [[Wintersday Cheer]] is active.

==Trivia==
* The gods' message to the Asura is a cryptogram, and can be solved with a [[w:substitution cipher|substitution cipher]], the specifics of which can be found [[Languages of Tyria#Ephemeral Spirit|here]]. The message reads:
:''"An offering to those who seek"''
:''"Beyond the mists beyond the dreams"''
:''"On distant shores of a land unwaking"''
:''"Answers there lie in waiting"''
* The same substitution cipher is used in ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'', in the [[gw2:Varajar Fells Notebook|Varajar Fells Notebook]].
* The Accept and Decline lines are quotes from the two famous phrases in [[W:X-Files|X-Files]], the Decline changed from "I want to believe"
